killedBy: hud.css: the stock-loss cue arms (issue #230) makes the control primitive INHERIT the family, which a <button> otherwise refuses
why: Returns every control in the game to the platform's Arial. A <button>'s UA `font` shorthand sets family, size and weight together and beats the family inherited from `.hud`, so without this declaration 269 of the 271 elements carrying `.ui-btn` compute `font-family: Arial` -- measured on the built page after #864 bundled the typeface. Nothing looks broken, which is why it survived #864: the buttons still render, just in a face the host chooses, so their text metrics keep the platform dependency the bundling existed to remove and the screen gate keeps comparing host-resolved boxes.
